ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, iconography, hairline rules, table borders — the only high-contrast element on the page

paper-warm-gray.$description: Paper Warm Gray — Card surfaces, soft fills, the single chromatic departure from pure white, gentle gradient origin

graphite-border.$description: Graphite Border — Subtle table dividers and secondary rule lines — used when #000000 would feel too heavy

bleach-white.$description: Bleach White — Supporting palette color for small decorative accents when the core palette needs contrast.

haasr.$description: Workhorse grotesque for body, subheadings, and mid-size headings. Weight 100 is used for restraint in body contexts; 700 sparingly for emphasis. The single most-used face carries the page.

haast.$description: Display-only face at 141px with tightened leading (0.90). Used for hero statements and singular set-pieces — the only moment typography shouts, and it shouts at full volume against pure white.

pt-mono.$description: Metadata, spec labels, catalog tags — the typographic equivalent of a printed museum label. Appears at 11px only; functions as a quiet signature rather than informational copy.
